verdict.rationale: Intuit publishes an official QuickBooks Online MCP server (documented at developer.intuit.com/.../mcp and mirrored in the intuit/quickbooks-online-mcp-server GitHub repo) offering 145 tools with full CRUD for 29 entity types and 11 financial reports, letting an AI agent connect directly to QBO data. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the MCP server working in practice and discoverability via standard machine-readable docs (llms.txt/openapi endpoints both 404).
